name: student-ide
description: XunJie-StudentIDE: a local Monaco IDE with static diagnostics, prepared language profiles and replayable coding logs.

interface.shortDescription: Connect languages on demand and inspect coding processes.
interface.longDescription: Open a local Monaco IDE in the right browser panel, register and verify project language profiles, read unsaved code, and replay compilation and execution. Journal storage is local; MCP exposes acknowledged code to the caller. This prototype is not a sandbox or an assessment system.
interface.defaultPrompt: 读取学生 IDE 已确认的代码与最近运行结果；需要准备环境时先核对会话阶段。
